newsitem.title: USA: Data Systems says to form year 2000 unit.
newsitem.headline: Data Systems says to form year 2000 unit.

text.p: Data Systems Network Corp said Friday it is forming a year 2000 practice aimed at government, institutional and corporate accounts.
The company said the practice, based in its consulting service group, will assess how clients can fix their computer system's year-2000 problem.
The company said it is forming the practice in response to clients' requests.
The year 2000 problem refers to the fact that many computer systems were programmed to only read the last two numbers of a date.
These systems are expected to crash as they begin making calculations involving the year 2000, since it is not read any differently from the year 1900.
